main_order.label: Main window section order
main_order.tooltip:
Top-to-bottom order of the sections in the main window: press the up/down arrows to move a section one step; changes apply and save immediately.
The automation controls always stay at the top and are not in this list.
Sections added later go to the end; sections that are not showing right now (e.g. Forked Tower) keep their place.
main_order.reset_tooltip: Go back to the original (default) order.
